summary.text: Tye Ward is the Libertarian candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A landscape contractor and U.S. Army National Guard veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running on the principle of protecting natural rights.

paragraphs.text: Ward served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2003 to 2010 and earned a bachelor's degree from Shepherd University in 2008.
His career experience includes working as a landscape contractor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Ward described himself as a blue-collar business owner rather than a politician and said he supports free-market economic policy and reducing government's influence on business and individuals.
He said lower taxes, lower spending and less regulation are West Virginia's path to success, and he named public education reform and funding and foster care reform among his policy interests.
